# Approve Tests — verify approve command behavior

# Setup: initialize a KB
exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

# --- Write draft note ---
stdin ../draft-note.md
exec akb write draft-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/draft-note.md'

# --- Approve draft note ---
exec akb approve notes/draft-note.md
stdout 'Approved ''notes/draft-note.md'''

# --- Verify annotations stripped ---
exec akb read notes/draft-note.md
! stdout 'olw-auto'

# --- Verify provenance markers stripped ---
exec akb read notes/draft-note.md
! stdout '\^\[inferred\]'
! stdout '\^\[ambiguous\]'
! stdout '\^\[extracted\]'

# --- Verify regular content preserved ---
exec akb read notes/draft-note.md
stdout 'Some content.'
stdout 'More content.'

# --- Write note with code blocks ---
stdin ../code-block-note.md
exec akb write code-block-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/code-block-note.md'

# --- Approve code block note ---
exec akb approve notes/code-block-note.md
stdout 'Approved ''notes/code-block-note.md'''

# --- Verify marker inside code block preserved ---
exec akb read notes/code-block-note.md
stdout '\^\[inferred\] Inside code.'

# --- Verify marker outside code block stripped ---
exec akb read notes/code-block-note.md
! stdout '\^\[inferred\] Outside code.'

# --- Write already-approved note ---
stdin ../approved-note.md
exec akb write approved-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/approved-note.md'

# --- Approve already-approved note is no-op ---
exec akb approve notes/approved-note.md
stdout 'Page ''notes/approved-note.md'' is already approved'

-- draft-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Draft Note
summary: A draft
tags: test
---
Some content.
<!-- olw-auto: action=review -->
^[inferred] A claim.
^[ambiguous] Another claim.
^[extracted] Data.
More content.

-- code-block-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Code Note
summary: Has code blocks
tags: test
---
^[inferred] Outside code.
```
^[inferred] Inside code.
```

-- approved-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Already Approved
summary: Pre-approved
tags: test
is_draft: false
---
Content here.
